title: 美国环保署署长：吸取教训，美国能源开发将更安全
speaker: Lee Zeldin

segments.en: Well, I mean, it's always important to remember lessons learned of the past, to be leaning into new technology,
segments.zh: 铭记过去的教训、拥抱新技术，这始终至关重要。

segments.en: to make sure that with new projects for extraction, for processing, anywhere in America, that in the partnerships and in the requests for permits.
segments.zh: 确保美国各地的开采和加工项目，在合作与许可申请中都能落实安全要求。

segments.en: And as this investment goes forward, that we are learning the lessons of the past that we're doing it as safely as possible.
segments.zh: 随着项目推进，我们要吸取历史教训，尽可能确保安全。

segments.en: I often talk about how I strongly believe that in the United States, we tap into our own energy supplies so much safer than so many other countries elsewhere around the world, and that runs across the gamut on all different kinds of ways that energy is extracted.
segments.zh: 我常说，美国开采本土能源的方式比世界许多国家都更安全，这适用于各种能源开采方式。

segments.en: So yeah, to your question, which is a great one, it's important that one of these projects, one of these permits are moving forward that we're doing it as responsibly as possible.
segments.zh: 所以，对于你的问题，重要的是这些项目在推进时，我们要尽可能负责任。
